title: service-settings: sys_setting_audit.old_hash is never written (hard-coded null) and new_hash for a non-secret value is an FNV-32 digest, while both columns declare "SHA-256 of the … value"
body:
Filing gate: ① a declared-but-unenforced field (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove), measured live. Found by a probe beside the clauses of a QA run.
Business reason: an operator reading the settings audit trail to see whether a change actually changed anything ("lets operators detect duplicate writes", in the column's own docblock) cannot. Every row's `old_hash` is null, including over a previously set value, and the digest format is not the one the schema promises.
Reader: the service-settings lane, at `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts` (the audit write) and `src/crypto-adapter.ts` (`digest`). The declarations are in `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-setting-audit.object.ts` and its twin `sys-platform-setting-audit.object.ts`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): searched "sys_setting_audit old_hash always null". The only hit is #23804 (closed, `sys_user_preference` writes not audited), which is a different defect.
reach: any settings write through `PUT /api/settings/:ns`. Measured on a fresh stock showcase boot, `756220c4`, as admin.
Checklist item priority: P1
type: Bug
QA-source: #26456 · platform-core.settings-hub-roundtrip · observed beside the clauses

## Reproduction
1. On a fresh showcase boot, the dev seed has already written `localization.timezone = UTC` (tenant). Its audit row carries `new_hash: "fnv32:582aa22d"`.
2. As admin, `PUT /api/settings/localization` with `{"timezone":"Asia/Tokyo"}` → 200.
3. Read the new audit row (`GET /api/v1/data/sys_setting_audit`, newest first). It shows `action: set`, `new_hash: "fnv32:43850a34"`, and **`old_hash: null`**, although the previous value was set.

**Expected**, per the declaration: `old_hash` holds the digest of the previous value ("Null when previously unset"), and both hashes are "SHA-256 of the … value (canonicalised)".
**Actual:** `old_hash` is always null, and non-secret digests are FNV-1a 32-bit.

## Mechanism
- `settings-service.ts:2498` passes `oldHash: null` on every write. The previous value is never read for the audit.
- For a non-secret value, the digest is `this.crypto.digest(stableStringify(rawValue))`, which is the adapter's FNV-1a (`crypto-adapter.ts:80–88`, "short, stable, non-cryptographic. Audit-only"). Secret values take a separate keyed digest, `secretAuditDigest`. That path is correct and is not part of this card.
- `sys-setting-audit.object.ts:137–156` declares both columns as SHA-256.

So the fix is either to write the previous value's digest and align the declared format (or the digest), or to remove or re-describe the column.
